findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hospital_prices, hospital_compare, medicare_partd_coverage, medicare_partd_plan, medicare_partd_changes · Private data: tax_sales_rate, tax_sales_rate_batch, tax_changes, hospital_prices, hospital_compare, hospital_payers, hospital_changes, medicare_pfs_rate, medicare_pfs_localities, medicare_pfs_changes, medicare_partd_coverage, medicare_partd_plan, medicare_partd_changes, drug_nadac, drug_nadac_search, drug_nadac_changes, sanctions_address, sanctions_address_batch, sanctions_changes · Public sink: tax_sales_rate, tax_sales_rate_batch, hospital_prices, medicare_pfs_rate · Destructive: sanctions_changes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hospital_prices, hospital_compare, medicare_partd_coverage, medicare_partd_plan, medicare_partd_changes · Private data: tax_sales_rate, tax_sales_rate_batch, tax_changes, hospital_prices, hospital_compare, hospital_payers, hospital_changes, medicare_pfs_rate, medicare_pfs_localities, medicare_pfs_changes, medicare_partd_coverage, medicare_partd_plan, medicare_partd_changes, drug_nadac, drug_nadac_search, drug_nadac_changes, sanctions_address, sanctions_address_batch, sanctions_changes · Public sink: tax_sales_rate, tax_sales_rate_batch, hospital_prices, medicare_pfs_rate · Destructive: sanctions_changes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
